limitations: All parking capacity scenarios are provisional.
Proximity does not establish parking ownership or store allocation.
Only parking near currently selected building candidates is modelled.
Unresolved store geometry may omit relevant parking candidates.
Shared parking is counted once in the union, not once per store.
Known building footprints are subtracted before modelling.
Only known covered/solar-tagged surfaces are withheld for review.
Existing solar installations may be untagged.
Bay fractions are borrowed scenario assumptions, not site measurements.
No layout, clearance, tree/shading, structural or grid assessment.
No permit, commercial-rights or economic feasibility assessment.
The scenarios are not confidence intervals or nationwide totals.
